sections.name: About Us
sections.copy: At Beauties Bespoke and SJA Stitches, we are passionate about creating fashion that tells your story. Located in the heart of Kosofe, Lagos, our studio combines traditional tailoring expertise with contemporary design innovation. Every stitch, every seam, every detail is executed with meticulous care to ensure your garments fit perfectly and reflect your personal style. Whether you're preparing for a special occasion or building your everyday wardrobe, we bring decades of experience and an unwavering commitment to quality. Our team takes pride in understanding your needs, offering expert guidance, and delivering pieces that make you look and feel extraordinary.

sections.name: Our Services
sections.copy:
**Bespoke Tailoring** – Custom-fitted garments designed specifically for your body and style preferences. From traditional attire to modern fashion, we create pieces that fit like a dream.

**Creative Design Consultation** – Work directly with our designers to bring your fashion vision to life. We guide you through fabric selection, style choices, and design elements.

**Wedding & Special Occasions** – Make your special day unforgettable with stunning custom designs for weddings, engagements, birthdays, and celebrations.

**Corporate & Casual Wear** – Professional attire that commands respect and casual pieces that showcase your personality, all tailored to perfection.

**Alterations & Repairs** – Expert alterations to ensure your existing garments fit flawlessly, plus professional repairs that restore your favorite pieces.

**Custom Embroidery & Embellishments** – Add unique touches with custom embroidery, beading, and decorative elements that make your garments truly one-of-a-kind.
